title: Can I BEAT Clobber?
summary: Clobber: a 5x6 board completely filled with alternating white and black stones; each move a stone captures an orthogonally adjacent enemy stone.
rules: Board 5 columns x 6 rows, every square filled, colours alternating in checker pattern.
A move: move one of your pieces onto an orthogonally adjacent square occupied by an enemy piece, capturing it (moves must capture).
Pieces cannot move to empty squares.
The player who cannot move loses (standard Clobber).
win_condition: Opponent has no legal move (last player to move wins).

custom_pieces.name: Stone
custom_pieces.moves: step orthogonally onto adjacent enemy only

setup: 5x6 full board alternating white/black pawns (white on a1).
